text:
marta: heads-up — kicking off canary for vega-15b (int4) on staging. streaming + defaults causes reproducible OOMs on coldstart when max_new_tokens=1024.

chris: paste the allocator error pls

marta: log snippet:
```
E runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
E runtime: failed to allocate KV cache slab (requested 256MB)
W kv: slot_growth > 1.6x after first generation
```

ine: we've hit this pattern before on 15b-ish models. streaming keeps KV alive and default max_new_tokens is too aggressive. quick mitigations: microbatch=1, lower canary max_new_tokens to 256, and tighten slot_reserve_ratio.

sam: pushed a canary config override:
```
microbatch: 1
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
kv:
  slot_reserve_ratio: 0.25
  soft_evict_threshold: 0.65
```

marta: applied via k8s rollout. deploy bot reports 3/3 healthy.

dev-bot: deploy: vega-15b-canary config patch applied by sam — rollout complete

marta: we still hit one OOM during a long multi-turn with function-calling (prompt prefix ~1.5k tokens). reproducer: streaming, prefix=~1500, user max_new_tokens=512. so prefix + streaming + big new-tokens = fail.

chris: propose prefix gating — if prompt_tokens > 1200, route to non-streaming path or reject with informative error. avoids unexpected KV growth.

ine: alternative: adaptive max_new = min(user_max, 1024 - prefix_tokens) for canary. simpler: conservative defaults and gating.

sam: also queued allocator soft-defrag after first generation (frees small slabs) — https://git.internal/r/infra/vega-kv-defrag.

marta: reran canary with config + defrag. 50 runs, 0 OOMs, mean latency +2%. harness notes:
- workload: streaming multi-turns (avg prefix 900 tokens)
- qps: 2
- runs: 50
- result: 0 OOM / 0 crash, 98th perc latency ~1.02x baseline

chris: OK. onboarding playbook updates: default canary max_new_tokens=256, microbatch=1 for streaming models >=13b, enable coldstart soft-defrag, add prefix gating rule.

marta: i'll open PR to onboarding docs with config snippet and kv heuristics. linking canary logs and perf dashboard.

sam: add alert: KV slot_growth > 1.4 within first 5 gens -> paging SRE + auto-rollback. :bell:

marta: added alert TODO in PR.

chris: once PR merged we can start slow rollout to prod.

marta: closing — canary healthy after fixes. will add checklist entry for future onboardings. :tada:
